note: The 32 named failure states of PRD §7/§7.1 in executable form. Generated from the PRD by Tools/make_failure_corpus.py; `status` and `evidence` are authored there because whether the product implements a state is not derivable from the document that specifies it.

states.cancellation: Cancel transport task; preserve draft/thread and accepted events
Reject late events; preserve accepted transcript and request a new ID on retry
Cancel obsolete generation/audio/lip sync; preserve current text/state
End capture attempt; never create audio/transcript data
Discard partial/unaccepted transcript; preserve composer and thread
End playback generation; preserve visible text/navigation
Stop/pause current generation and revalidate before explicit resume
Delete proposal/authorization; preserve conversation and do not reprompt automatically
Stop cursor advance; preserve both versions until explicit/deterministic resolution
states.gap: No sync client, cursor or conflict resolution exists.

states.cancellation: Cancel network auth/sync; preserve local state and already-consented outbox
Abort/quarantine staging atomically; preserve active character
Cancel animated load; select validated portrait then bundled static fallback
Cancel load generation and release once; preserve session/journey controls
Block activation/redistribution; retain private inspection receipt only
Stop collection request; clear pending exact snapshot and keep manual actions
Reject stale/inaccurate sample; preserve last confirmed place as historical, not current
states.gap: A non-finite or negative accuracy is rejected, but a merely inaccurate fix is only widened into the off-route allowance rather than refused, and sample age is never examined. Choosing an accuracy ceiling and a staleness window needs field evidence (G4), so neither is invented here.

states.cancellation: Cancel auto-confirm; preserve candidate set until choice/clear
Cancel remote wait without reverting local session override
states.gap: A correction applies locally and immediately and survives later readings that disagree with it, which is the half that protects the user. There is nothing to submit it to: no place service exists, so there is no remote case, no acknowledgement and therefore no pending status to show.

states.cancellation: End capture attempt; create no image/upload record
End selection attempt; create no copied/uploaded asset
Reject auto-replacement; preserve confirmed subject and candidates
Cancel factual narration for unsupported claims; allow clearly non-factual content
Cancel single-certainty projection; preserve conflicting revisions
Cancel/supersede timed-out operation; keep cached/accepted state
Stop affected tour action; preserve last valid pack and unrelated downloads
Abort activation and quarantine candidate; keep last valid pointer
states.gap: Schema, rights, expiry, per-file hashes, undeclared content and traversal are all refused, the candidate is sealed only after every check passes, and a refusal leaves the installed pack untouched. What is missing is a signature: self-declared hashes prove integrity, not publisher authenticity, so no pack can yet be attributed to anyone (the same gap DEC-010 records for character packages).

states.cancellation: Cancel any new-route request; keep cached route and return guidance only
Do not start in-app navigation; hand off only after explicit confirmation
states.gap: No navigation start and no system-maps handoff exist.

states.cancellation: Abort atomic import/download/export; remove staging and preserve current data
states.gap: Travel-pack import is complete: the exact byte requirement is known before anything is copied, the refusal carries required and available, and a failed copy removes its staging directory rather than leaving a partial one. Character-package import is not covered — its expanded size is only known while streaming, and telling the user what to free up needs a failure reason carrying both numbers, which widens a taxonomy the Kotlin core mirrors and the conformance vectors cover. Export does not exist at all (`JM-P0-023`).

states.cancellation: Cancel missing asset request; apply and label the declared fallback chain
states.gap: The current lane is zh-Hans only, so no locale fallback chain is exercised (DEC-007).

states.cancellation: Keep local deletion final; retry tombstone without resurrecting payload
states.gap: No remote deletion or tombstone exists.

states.cancellation: Stop completion claim; preserve failure/audit proof and safe retry identity
states.gap: Local deletion refuses to report success it cannot verify, for memory records and for character installations. Remote acknowledgement does not exist, so no 'complete' claim is possible to block yet.
